structuralSignatures.interpretation: Mansfield's epiphanies land 3.3% later — atmospheric revelation deferred longer.
Mansfield places epiphanies more consistently (σ=18.0 vs 29.1), suggesting disciplined atmospheric timing.
Joyce uses more absentials per event (0.195 vs 0.189) — desire, absence, and longing are the dominant structural engine.
Joyce's stories carry more named entities per event (1.909 vs 1.653) — richer social texture.
Mansfield's stories average 49 events vs Joyce's 36 — more incident-rich narrative worlds.
Joyce back-loads tension (score=-0.187) — building toward late revelation.

interpretation: Joyce and Mansfield share a late-revelation structural shape but diverge most on absential tension (distance=0.011). Joyce's epiphanies arrive at 82% vs Mansfield's 85.3%. Joyce's stories are more absential-dense (ratio 0.195 vs 0.189), encoding paralysis as unfulfilled desire. Mansfield's stories are incident-richer (49.3 events avg vs 36.1) despite often being shorter. They converge most strongly on atmospheric tension, suggesting both authors use similar atmospheric/environmental pressure regardless of story content. Structural signatures suggest that "Joyce-shaped" stories build absential tension early and hold it as paralysis; "Mansfield-shaped" stories distribute tension across social encounters with a final atmospheric revelation.
